_what: Gate scripts CI runs that are NOT yet proved by planting a violation in scripts/audit-gates.ts. The list may shrink, never grow.
_why_these_are_allowed: They pre-date the ratchet. When it was written the maturity plan recorded '100% coverage, 11/11 today' — 11 was the number of CASES, targeting 9 gate files out of the 31 CI runs. These are the rest, recorded rather than quietly carried. Each note says what the gate guards and how hard a planted case would be, so whoever picks up Block C step 3 does not start by re-deriving that.
_how_to_fix: Add a case to scripts/audit-gates.ts that plants the violation the gate claims to catch, confirm `bun run audit:gates` goes red without the gate and green with it, then delete the entry here. This gate fails if an entry is still listed once its case exists.

not_a_gate.scripts/schema-codegen.ts: Generates the Kysely types. It asserts nothing about the code; the assertion is schema-drift-check.ts, which compares its output against what is committed.
not_a_gate.scripts/merge-coverage.ts: Unions lcov files so the two suites can be scored together. Its exit(1) is malformed input, not a code defect; the assertion is coverage-gate.ts.
not_a_gate.scripts/sync-engine-version.ts: Writes the engine version into the places that must agree. Produces an artifact; the release gate is what refuses a mismatch.

uncovered.scripts/audit-gates.ts: The meta-gate itself. Plantable and worth doing: add a case whose gate command is a script that always exits 0, and audit-gates must report it as decoration. Until then its own correctness rests on reading it.
uncovered.scripts/audit-inventory.ts: Inventory behind the audit regression check. Classified as a gate rather than a report because it can exit non-zero; confirm which before writing a case.
uncovered.scripts/audit-regression-check.ts: Fails CI when a handler that should call auditLog stops calling it. Plant: strip an auditLog call from a listed handler.
uncovered.scripts/check-ambient-authority.ts: Extensions must not reach for ambient authority (process.env). Easy plant: one extension file reading process.env.
uncovered.scripts/check-atomic-writes.ts: A handler that writes twice must say so. Ratcheted. Plant: a second write in a handler not on the list.
uncovered.scripts/check-duplicate-rules.ts: A security rule is implemented once. Plant: a second implementation of a listed rule.
uncovered.scripts/check-extension-i18n-ownership.t: Every key an extension's Studio page renders belongs to that extension. Reads the sibling repo — a case must plant there, which no existing case does.
uncovered.scripts/check-extension-page-ownership.t: An extension's Studio page belongs to the extension. Same sibling-repo constraint as above.
uncovered.scripts/check-extension-sdui-schemas.ts: Extension SDUI schema files must declare sduiSchema + title. Sibling repo.
uncovered.scripts/check-insert-schema-match.ts: Does this INSERT match the table it writes to? (ext:seam). Needs a live database to know the table shape — a case must carry that, which is why it has none.
uncovered.scripts/check-migration-safety.ts: Lints NEW migrations for upgrade hazards (squawk). MEASURED, not guessed: it selects files with `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM ${BASE_REF:-origin/master}...HEAD`, so an unstaged plant is invisible — it answers 'No new or changed migrations to check' and exits 0. A case needs a plant the meta-gate stages, which it cannot do today. The same shape as import-boundaries, which was provable only because appending to a TRACKED file leaves it modified.
uncovered.scripts/check-pooldb-txn-skip.ts: A poolDb router must not run inside the request transaction — the c=DB_POOL_MAX standstill. Plant: a fifth pool-backed router absent from TXN_SKIP_PREFIXES.
uncovered.scripts/check-sdui-contract.ts: An SDUI schema is a promise about an API; this checks the API keeps it. Needs the running API surface.
uncovered.scripts/check-studio-embed-freshness.ts: Studio build output must carry a version marker matching package.json. Plant: stale marker. Needs a built Studio, which the Lint lane does not have.
uncovered.scripts/check-test-leftovers.ts: A test run must not leave collections or ghost tables behind — the gate whose absence produced a 364 ms measurement that was really 0,93 ms. Needs TEST_DATABASE_URL, so the plant is a row inserted into a live database, not a file.
uncovered.scripts/check-worker-source-fresh.ts: The embedded worker runtime is the one in the repository. Plant: edit the source without rebuilding the embed.
uncovered.scripts/coverage-gate.ts: Coverage ratchet (H-02). Reads a baseline rather than re-measuring; a case would have to produce an lcov below it.
uncovered.scripts/lint-warning-ratchet.ts: Lint-warning ratchet. Plant: a new warning above the baseline.
uncovered.scripts/release-gate.ts: H-16 release gate. Runs --dry-run in CI; a case must plant whatever the dry run refuses.
uncovered.scripts/route-collision-check.ts: Route-ordering collisions. Easy plant: a route registered after one that shadows it.
uncovered.scripts/schema-drift-check.ts: The committed Kysely types match what codegen produces. Easy plant: edit the generated file.
uncovered.scripts/schema-snapshot.ts: What the database looks like after a real install, recorded so a change cannot pass unnoticed. Needs a live installed database.
uncovered.scripts/sync-shared-message-keys.ts: In --check mode: the SDK's copy of the shared Studio vocabulary is in sync. Easy plant: add a key to the source without regenerating.
